newsitem.title: USA: United Petroleum to drill oil, gas wells.
newsitem.headline: United Petroleum to drill oil, gas wells.

text.p: United Petroleum Corp said Thursday it has finalized an agreement with Kastle Resources to drill 200 oil wells in Ohio and 50 gas wells in Pennsylvania over the next two years.
United Petroleum will hold a 75 percent investment in the Pennsylvania drilling project, and 70 percent in the Ohio oil wells. Kastle will provide the rest of the investment.
With the signing of the agreement, United Petroleum placed in escrow funds for the first 14 wells, seven in each state.
Drilling is to begin in Pennsylvania next week, the company said. Ohio drilling is to begin the first week in October, it said.
The initial schedule calls for the completion of 20 wells in Pennsylvania and 15 wells in Ohio by December 31.
The sites where United Petroleum and Kastle will drill are located within proven fields, United Petroleum said.
